name: Skillfite.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Skillfite.io is an io game that combines MMORPG, throwing you into live multiplayer showdowns against 100 players. Develop skills, craft gear, and team up or battle for loot. Train 5 skills, gather 17 different resources, and forge 20+ weapons and armor in this Gatarn Games-backed thrill with weekly updates. Prepare for gaming excitement!
